title: Agent Debugger
attachHint: Pick an agent session from the list to set breakpoints.
description: Pause an agent before a tool call that matches a breakpoint, inspect its input, then let it continue or skip it. Works with every provider and stack.
noSessionsHint: A session appears here as soon as an agent runs a task, on any provider.
noFramesHint: When an agent hits a breakpoint, the call waits here for your decision.
